# Pharmacy Commons

> Pharmacy Commons is a free, open-access pharmacology reference that manages drug knowledge as a public commons. Records are built from public and federal sources (FDA, WHO, NIH, NLM and others), modeled in a relational PostgreSQL database, and every fact traces back to its source. Where sources disagree, the disagreement is shown rather than resolved silently.

Pharmacy Commons is an educational resource for clinical and public inquiry. It is not a substitute for direct medical evaluation or the clinical judgment of a licensed practitioner.

Every medicine has a stable identifier, the PCID (Pharmacy Commons Identifier), and a permanent address at `https://pharmacycommons.org/id/PCID-<number>`. Search and browse list active moieties; salts, precise forms, brands and combinations nest under the moiety's page.

## Main pages

- [Browse the catalog](https://pharmacycommons.org/browse): every active ingredient, A to Z. Search with `/browse?q=<term>`.
- [Drug pages](https://pharmacycommons.org/drugs/metformin): one page per active moiety at `/drugs/<slug>`, with identifiers, classes, FDA labeling, brands and sources.
- [Drug classes](https://pharmacycommons.org/classes): pharmacologic, therapeutic and chemical classes from RxClass, ClassyFire and ChemOnt.
- [Lists](https://pharmacycommons.org/lists): compendium lists such as the most-used drugs in the US and Georgia MPJE drug lists.
- [Tools](https://pharmacycommons.org/tools): clinical calculators, including creatinine clearance.
- [About](https://pharmacycommons.org/about): mission, values, licensing and founder.
- [References](https://pharmacycommons.org/references): how to cite records, and the datasets the Commons is built from, with licenses.
- [Resources](https://pharmacycommons.org/resources): outside guidelines, trial registries, drug lists and safety tools that are not data sources.

## Data and licensing

- Code: GPL-3.0-or-later. Content authored by Pharmacy Commons: CC0 1.0. Third-party fields keep their source license, and each record states the scope.
- [Source code and data exports](https://github.com/JoshuaSemock/pharmacycommons.org)
- [Machine-readable API design](https://github.com/JoshuaSemock/pharmacycommons.org/blob/main/docs/machine-readable-api.md)

## Contact

- Corrections and questions: contact@pharmacycommons.org
